content.title: Are grocery stores closed on Easter? Is Walmart, Aldi, Food Lion open?
content.text: April 5, 2026, 2:55 a.m. ETEaster is April 5, marking an important holiday in the Christian faith.The holiday, which follows a 40-day period known as Lent, celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ. The date Easter is celebrated changes from year to year because it is one of several "moveable feasts" in the liturgical year, according to the History Channel.Some retail and restaurant chains will be closed on April 5 in observance of the holiday.
